notes.title: Update – Version 1.2.0267 – October 26th, 2017
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have a new update for Deponia Doomsday, adding a few subtitles and various fixes.

Engine Update to Visionaire 5.0.1

Additions and fixes

Added: DirectX 9 and DirectX 11 Renderpath Support
Added: Simplified Chinese subtitles
Added: Turkish subtitles
Added: Czech subtitles
Added: Visionaire Config Tool 2.0 for Windows, Mac OS X and Linux with additional languages
Added: Banner links in main menue for Linux
Fixed: Improved Lipsyncing in several combinations of text languages without voice over
Fixed: Several typos in Russian translation
Fixed: Minor localization issues in German and English language
Fixed: Items disappear when used as cursor on Skip/Reset buttons
Fixed: Inventory could be opened right before some cutscenes and stayed open all along
Fixed: Inventory couldn't be opened after trying to access the lift (being full of fewlocks)
Fixed: Some Walkmap glitches
Fixed: Cursor issues in sauna scene
Fixed: Rare problems with timer puzzles when using savegames while the timer is active
Fixed: Possible situation of a missing dialog option with Tuck
Fixed: Possibility to lose the answers from the Architect and get stuck with asking the fortune teller about hat fashion 
Added: Moving hotspot marker for the chasing elephant
Fixed: Letterboxing problems on some displays when switching resolutions
Fixed: High DPI Scaling not recognized correctly on all systems
Fixed: On some Hybrid GPU Systems the dedicated GPU wasn't correctly actived instead of the integrated GPU. 
Fixed: Problems with Achievements synching on some systems
Added: Option to lock the cursor to the game window in the Configuration Tool
Fixed: Steam: Achievements not triggering reliable on Mac OS X
